verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual says a private key for your Identity can be generated inside the app or imported, and that SSH keys can live on the Secure Enclave behind Face ID or Touch ID. Combined with SSH protocol support, this enables password-less SSH authentication to git servers, including self-hosted ones. Missing for 10: documentation of exporting or installing the public key on servers, supported key types and options, SSH use beyond git remotes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of key generation.
